title: Source component decomposition through pointwise reduction and limit
statement: For every independent expression and input family, the existing sourceShiftComponent equals the composition of the pointwise input-reduction shift isomorphism, the expression integral-system shift and the fixed total-limit commShift component, with the explicit endpoint equality transports shown in its Lean declaration.

source.place: Step 2, source shift component: pointwise reduction, context shift and total-limit shift.

proof.text: Expand sourceShiftComponent and sourceShift. Use the pointwise reduction component equation to replace the reduction-and-context endpoint transports by the map of the pointwise input shift. Then use the definitions of sourceShift and the explicit dependent update equality to identify the remaining context endpoints. Functoriality of coefficientSequenceLimit and associativity yield the displayed equality.

theorem IndependentExpression.sourceShiftComponent_decomposition
    {B : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} {X : I → Over B}
    (o : Operations l E) {W : Over B}
    (e : IndependentExpression B I X W)
    (M : ∀ j, Integral l E (X j).left) (i : I) (r : ℤ) :
    e.sourceShiftComponent l E o M i r =
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l E W.left).mapIso
        ((e.val.evaluate (systemInterpretation l E o)).mapIso
            ((pointwiseInputShiftIso (C := fun j ↦ Integral l E (X j).left)
              (D := fun j ↦ System l E (X j).left)
              (fun j ↦ (calculus l E (X j).left).reduction)
              (fun j ↦ reductionShift l E (X j).left) i r).app M) ≪≫
          (e.val.evaluate (systemInterpretation l E o)).mapIso
            (eqToIso (inputShift_obj _ ((inputReduction l E X).obj M) i r)) ≪≫
          e.shift (systemInterpretation l E o) (systemShifts l E o)
            ((inputReduction l E X).obj M) i r) ≪≫
        (Functor.commShiftIso (coefficientSequenceLimit l E W.left)
          (self := limitShift l E W.left) r).app
          ((e.val.evaluate (systemInterpretation l E o)).obj
            ((inputReduction l E X).obj M))
